title: fix(config): expand environment variables in trusted auth tokens
body:
## Summary

Expand environment variables in `authToken` values from global `config.yaml` and `pnpm_config__auth`, covering both pnpm implementations. Registry and scope keys keep their existing validation and routing behavior.

Closes pnpm/pnpm#12828.

Validation: TypeScript config reader tests (354 passed), Rust config and env-replace tests (784 passed), full repository pre-push checks (TypeScript compile/lint, Rust formatter, workspace Clippy, rustdoc, Dylint, spelling, and TOML formatting). Local HTTP probes with both CLIs confirmed that global and environment auth sources send the expanded bearer token.

## Squash Commit Body

```text
Expand trusted authToken values after merging global and environment auth
sources, preserving source precedence and registry routing. Reuse the
existing substitution helpers and add missing-only fallback support to
the Rust helper so both implementations support ${NAME-fallback}.

Cover default and scoped tokens, fallbacks, escaped placeholders, and
warnings that do not expose resolved credentials.

Closes pnpm/pnpm#12828.
```

## Checklist

- [x] I checked the referenced issue and verified that none of the PRs
  already linked to it solves it.
- [x] New features are implemented only in the Rust pnpm v12 CLI. Bug fixes
  are implemented in every affected version.
- [x] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this PR changes any published
  package. Keep it short and written for pnpm users — it becomes a release note.
- [x] Added or updated tests.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Environment-variable placeholders in authentication tokens from global configuration and `pnpm_config__auth` are now expanded.
  * Both `${VAR-default}` and `${VAR:-default}` fallback forms are supported. The former uses the fallback only when the variable is missing; the latter also uses it when the variable is empty.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Unresolved or empty placeholders in authentication tokens now generate warnings without exposing resolved secret values.
